title: Onboarding flow after this quarter's changes
variant: Heat strip: every dimension in one segmented bar
prompt: Score our product's onboarding flow after this quarter's changes.
note: A heat strip: all seven dimensions as one wide segmented bar toned by score, on a brand-tinted paper ground at a wider measure, because the product team reads this in a planning meeting and wants the shape of the funnel before any single number. The overall sits in the header beside the title as a numeric out of 100 with its delta, the evidence is a compact two-column ledger with a score chip per row, strengths and weaknesses are icon-led lists, and each comparable is a shorter copy of the same strip so peers are read by pattern rather than by figure.
